correctness.rationale: Every selected original set uniquely forces internal subdivisions; the remaining selected internal-edge subdivisions form a matching and unused excluded originals make independent weighted boundary-edge choices. The converse meets the external-neighbor condition. Complete-graph matchings give the claimed closed polynomial. Interval endpoints yield exact support and a gap sum of floor((n-1)^2/4). The connected-graph maximum proper size follows by charging every selected noninternal subdivision to a distinct excluded original vertex and attaining the bound at one minimum-degree vertex. Independent direct enumeration passed 1099 labelled graph comparisons, 771 connected maxima, and complete-graph size-profile tests through order 25.

value.rationale: The matched-subdivision structure yields an exact all-coefficient enumerator for a natural graph operation and a closed two-level formula for a canonical infinite family. The complete-family convex-set size spectrum has a quadratic number of genuine forbidden cardinalities with growing gaps, and the largest proper convex set of any connected subdivision is governed by the original minimum degree. These are motivated structural enumeration and boundary theorems, not arbitrarily chosen small graph instances or a complexity claim.
